How We Built This (Without Losing Our Minds):

Bringing the 1985 ThunderCats into the 4K era takes more than just a magic sword. Our "technical" process involved a chaotic mix of high-end AI, creative experimentation, and a suspicious amount of caffeine.

We leaned on Claude to help refine the story and craft image and video prompts, then unleashed Nano-Banana, GPT-Image 2, and Seedance 2.5 to generate the hyper-realistic visuals and cinematic sequences you see here.

Of course, there were a few moments when the AI seemed convinced that Snarf was the main character, the Sword of Omens was a kitchen utensil, and continuity was merely a suggestion.

It's a wild time to be a creator when your "camera crew" is a series of complex algorithms, your production studio exists entirely in the cloud, and one of your most important collaborators is a digital banana!

But the real magic isn't the technology. It's bringing the characters and stories we grew up loving back to life.
